en.WelcomeMsg: Hello, you are now connected with a NAMI HelpLine Specialist. How can I best support you today?
en.GoodbyeMsg: Your conversation is now closed. Because we care about your experience and want to provide the best possible support, you'll now receive a message inviting you to share your feedback. Your responses will help us improve our services for everyone.
en.EndChatMsg: You ended the chat. Thank you for reaching out. Please contact us again if you need more help.
en.ClosedOutOfShift: The helpline is out of shift, please reach us later.
en.ClosedHolidays: The helpline is closed due to a holiday.
en.UnsupportedMediaErrorMsg: Sorry, the message you just sent is unsupported and could not be delivered.
